question.problem: The surface area of a sphere is $144\pi \,{\text{in}}^{2}.$ Find the volume of the sphere.
question.worked_solution:
We can calculate the surface area of a sphere using the formula

$$
S=4\pi {r}^{2},
$$

where $r$ is the radius of the sphere.

Substituting $S=144\pi \,{\text{in}}^{2}$ into the above formula, we can solve for $r$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}S & =4\pi {r}^{2} \\ 144\pi  & =4\pi {r}^{2} \\ \frac{144\pi }{4\pi } & ={r}^{2} \\ {r}^{2} & =36 \\ r & =6\,\text{in}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Finally, we  can find the volume of the sphere as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}V & =\frac{4}{3}\pi {r}^{3} \\  & =\frac{4}{3}\pi (6)^{3} \\  & =288\pi \,{\text{in}}^{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
